articles.summary: SES AI Corporation (“SES AI,” the “Company,” “we” or “us”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance NDAA-compliant Li-ion and Anode-Free Li-Metal batteries, today announced it will release its 2026 third quarter financial results before market opens on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET. A webcast of the live conference call will be available through SES’s Investor Relations website, https://investors.ses.ai . The following link can be used to register in advance for the call: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/310176029 . articles.summary: Stronger-Than-Expected Customer Demand Drives Plans for Immediate Expansion SES AI Corporation (“SES AI,” the “Company,” “we” or “us”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced that it has completed the ramp up of its drone battery plant in Chungju, Korea, to an annual production capacity of one million NDAA-compliant cells. Driven by stronger than expected customer demand, the Company plans to immediately begin expanding the plant further, to three million NDAA-compliant cells per year by the second quarter of 2027. SES AI owns and operates the Chungju facility, which has produced NDAA-compliant cells since 2021. The total capacity will primarily cover high-silicon Li-ion cells and anode-free Li-Metal cells, with cell sizes ranging from 6Ah to 30Ah. articles.title: SES AI Completes Ramp of Korea Drone Battery Plant to One Million NDAA-Compliant Cells Per Year, and Plans to Further Expand to Three Million NDAA-Compliant Cells Per Year by Second Quarter 2027
